location_note: Grounds of the Ministry of Justice building west of Sallah ed-Din Street, 400-500 m north of the Old City walls; no map reference found. Placed by the title name Jerusalem (Z4).
notes: 1998-1999 salvage excavation. Three phases: early quarry (1st c. CE, source for the 'Third Wall'), Late Roman cemetery (mid-2nd to 4th c. CE; 57 cist tombs, four one-chamber burial caves with troughs; Cave II seen only at its entrance), Byzantine quarry. The 1962 tombs (Prag 1995) and Iron Age monumental caves are cited; not coded.

features.subtype: 57 rock-cut cist tombs and four rock-cut burial caves, each one chamber with burial troughs (Cave I with entrance shaft)
features.period: Late Roman, mid-2nd to 4th c. CE
features.quote: A large burial ground from the Late Roman period was exposed

features.subtype: open stone quarry with terraces c. 2 m high and detachment channels (blocks up to 1.3 x 2.0 m)
features.period: late Second Temple period, 1st c. CE (pottery; Agrippa I coin); out of use before the 2nd c. CE
features.quote: this particular quarry functioned mainly during the late Second Temple period

features.subtype: stone quarry with undetached blocks and severance channels, cutting the cemetery
features.quote: quarrying in this area was renewed in the Byzantine period
